comment:
Maintainer review of `f364b97ff4700147fc06e622b79952b9fe6c4fa8`: the declared finite replay passes, and the abstract typed-echo construction, pricing exercise, and handoffs are useful. Before incorporation, please reconcile the README's admission language with its own stated missing obligations.

The opening says this is a supplier instantiation “blocked in exactly one obligation, hosting”; the shared-ledger section says the projected figure is “here reached by a concrete mechanism rather than a relaxation”; and the obstruction section says “Everything else is charged and closes.” But the same note explicitly says no named host child exposes `R P = Q R`, the two calls need a common sink, and the host precision bucket law is not closed. The abstract 56-column echo and the hypothetical shared histogram do not establish that the selected reader implements the typed child or that its rank-8 calls can be removed.

Please label the shared histogram and projected exponent as conditional pricing, distinguish the checked abstract echo from an actual selected-supplier instantiation, and list reader/intertwiner realization, delivery/lifetime and precision as remaining obligations (they can share a research program, but none follows from the arithmetic). Preserve all finite certificates and predecessor credit. PR #2491's reader obstruction and PR #2502's local precision handoff are relevant follow-ups already linked here; neither should be silently treated as full host admission.

This is a claim-scope revision request, not a rejection of the finite echo identity or its scalar saving. No selected-frontier change is being inferred from the replay.
